mutations.description: Add an unregistered noninformational check identity; require rejection.
mutations.oracle: nonzero checker exit and unregistered-identity diagnostic

mutations.description: Flip a required check pass outcome; require rejection.
mutations.oracle: nonzero checker exit and pass-outcome diagnostic

mutations.description: Change a measurement array shape; require rejection.
mutations.oracle: nonzero checker exit and exact length diagnostic

mutations.description: Change a stable configuration beyond tolerance; require rejection.
mutations.oracle: nonzero checker exit and stable-input tolerance diagnostic

mutations.description: Make a required visual empty and untracked; require both defects.
mutations.oracle: checker reports both not-tracked and empty; exact bytes restored

mutations.description: Move a sensitive scientific diagnostic beyond its frozen threshold; require rejection.
mutations.oracle: both canonical copies changed and checker rejects frozen tolerance

mutations.description: Activate an untracked sitecustomize.py through PYTHONPATH; require boundary rejection.
mutations.oracle: complete frozen boundary rejects both untracked hook and blocked environment

mutations.description: Preplant ignored .venv startup hooks before locked sync; require preflight and postflight rejection.
mutations.oracle: ignored-state preflight and startup-hook postflight both reject

mutations.description: Inject executable .pth hooks; isolated commands must ignore them and postflight reject them.
mutations.oracle: extra and modified-allowed .pth variants execute only in project Python and fail postflight

mutations.description: Make the editable project .pth self-clean; require non-editable sync and execution to eliminate it.
mutations.oracle: historical carrier controls interpreter/checker, self-cleans, then amended boundary eliminates it
